'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Tom Schwarz LS Tatooine: Slave Quarters''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Schwarz]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Slave Quarters|Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Karakagin
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
